paragraphs: This document is the written Fleet management agreement for Panamerica Auto, LLC (trade name Panamerica Auto Rentals).
Read the full agreement (PDF) and Exhibit A (Vehicle Schedule).

When the owner-final document is published, this file is the single source for the Fleet management agreement. The public commission rates on /management are the published price; the written agreement confirms the terms for a vehicle.
To review current terms or place a vehicle, write panamerica.cars@gmail.com.
